a2-161.title: Communicative Challenge: Do You Trust Me?
a2-161.scenario: Károly asks Meg whether she trusts him, and whether she is sure that Anna will come to the party tonight.
a2-161.prompt: Answer both of Károly's questions: say that you trust him, and that you are sure of it.
cues: Say that you are sure of it
a2-161.target: Bízom benned, és biztos vagyok benne.
a2-161.english: I trust you, and I am sure of it.
a2-161.canDo: I can use inessive personal pronouns (bennem, benned, benne...) accurately.

a2-162.title: Communicative Challenge: Your Turn
a2-162.scenario: Meg, Károly and Anna are playing a game at home. Károly is hesitating and cannot decide what to do.
a2-162.prompt: Tell Károly that it is his turn and that the decision is up to him.
cues: Say that it is his turn
Say that the decision depends on him
a2-162.target: Most rajtad van a sor, és a döntés is rajtad múlik.
a2-162.english: Now it is your turn, and the decision is up to you too.
a2-162.canDo: I can use superessive personal pronouns (rajtam, rajtad, rajta...) in context.

a2-163.title: Communicative Challenge: Wait for Me
a2-163.scenario: Meg is going to be late. Károly is already at the station and is waiting. You phone him.
a2-163.prompt: Ask Károly to wait for you at the station, and say that you often think of him.
cues: Ask him to wait for you at the station
Say that you often think of him
a2-163.target: Kérlek, várj rám az állomáson! Sokat gondolok rád.
a2-163.english: Please wait for me at the station! I think of you a lot.
a2-163.canDo: I can use sublative personal pronouns (rám, rád, rá...) with verbs of direction, waiting, and thought.

a2-164.title: Communicative Challenge: You Can Count on Me
a2-164.scenario: Anna is nervous before an important presentation. You (Meg) sit next to her and want to support her.
a2-164.prompt: Tell Anna that you trust her, that she can count on you, and that it all depends on her.
cues: Say that she can count on you
Say that it all depends on her
a2-164.target: Bízom benned, és számíthatsz rám. Minden rajtad múlik.
a2-164.english: I trust you, and you can count on me. It all depends on you.
a2-164.canDo: I can contrast inessive, superessive, and sublative personal pronouns.

a2-165.title: Communicative Challenge: Before the Exam
a2-165.scenario: Károly has an important exam tomorrow and is very nervous. You (Meg) are with him.
a2-165.prompt: Encourage Károly: tell him not to be nervous, that you trust him, and that you are thinking of him.
cues: Tell him not to be nervous
Say that you are thinking of him
a2-165.target: Ne izgulj, bízom benned! Gondolok rád.
a2-165.english: Don't be nervous, I trust you! I am thinking of you.
a2-165.canDo: I can offer encouragement and moral support using declined pronouns.

a2-165-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: A Quiz Evening
a2-165-consolidation.scenario: Meg, Károly and Anna are at a family quiz evening. Károly is next, and he is nervous.
a2-165-consolidation.prompt: Tell Károly that you trust him, that you are waiting for him, and that it is his turn.
cues: Say that you are waiting for him
Say that it is his turn
a2-165-consolidation.target: Bízom benned, rád várok, és most rajtad van a sor.
a2-165-consolidation.english: I trust you, I am waiting for you, and now it is your turn.
a2-165-consolidation.canDo: I can use inessive, superessive and sublative personal pronouns.
